decisions.statement: This route is asked without a session and answers without any page's content.
Going red here is a report rather than a kill.
Going red at the liveness probe kills the container and pulls the replica out.
A read answering no page is red rather than green.
An empty answer is the shape a broken read makes when the read is not raising.
Every red the route can answer is shown by a test seeding that fault.

definition: whether this pod can read a page
